request.description: Circular mage passive-tree keystone icon, 48x48 native pixel art. A small hooded mage silhouette enclosed by a cobalt mana bubble, a single incoming ember being caught and converted into a bright cyan drop at the mage's raised palm. Abstract character pose and aura composition, clear at small size, deep navy shadows, pale cyan highlights, restrained violet. Transparent outside the compact central circular composition. Match reference's crisp clusters, painted RPG pixel texture and cool mana palette. No heraldic shield, no physical shield object, no shield badge, no lettering, no numbers, no frame, no UI border. Opaque painted forms, not a soft blurry VFX cloud.
